Your Journey Begins with the
Best Pediatric Care in Arizona

Agave Pediatrics provides holistic and comprehensive care for your little ones, with an emphasis on prevention. From routine check-ups to specialized care, our providers are equipped with the knowledge and expertise to address a wide range of health needs of your family.

We take care of their overall well-being by providing a wide array of appointments by our multidisciplinary team. Our compassionate providers take pride in fostering a nurturing environment where your kids thrive and reach their maximum potential. 

Our motto is ‘Growing Healthy Children,’ and that is what we do the best!

Parent Chronicles: Navigating Parenthood with Agave Pediatrics - Your Trusted Pediatric Doctor in Every Chapter!

View All Reviews

Brandy Orona

I just wanted to say that Dr. Agarwal is amazing!! My son was diagnosed late with a posterior tongue tie. It was so painful for me to breastfeed and my son was on me literally all day long. Something didn’t seem right so I went and saw Debbie Gillespie a lactation consultant and she told me my son had a posterior tongue tie. It was taking him over an hour to get 4oz of milk out of me. No wonder he was on me all day.

​

She referred me to Dr. Agarwal and he gave us treatment options. We opted to get his frenulum cauterized. Dr. A did explain that it is not guaranteed for him to breastfeed successfully. Breastfeeding was very important to me and I really wanted to be successful so we took the chance & even if it didn’t help with breastfeeding the procedure it would help Ethan when he got older. So Ethan had the procedure done at about one month of age. After about 2 months after procedure we were able to successfully breastfeed!! Thank you so so much Dr. Agarwal!! You are amazing!!
